ns2:course.label: Intro Kines & Community Health
ns2:course.description: Serves as an introduction to the Kinesiology and Community Health Department and provides an overview of the Kinesiology and Community Health curricula, areas of study, and opportunities available for a career in the field. Enrollment required for Kinesiology freshmen and transfer students. Credit is not given for both KIN 125 and CHLH 125.
